subject: Evergreen renewal: finalizing QBR demo slot & procurement onramp

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Dec 2028 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Evergreen renewal: QBR demo — slot options and procurement next steps

Hi Liam / Maya,

Thanks again for the productive pre-call earlier. We want to lock a firm slot for the renewal QBR + roadmap demo (45 min + 15 min buffer) the week of Dec 11 so we can include the execs and ops team. To avoid back-and-forth, here are two final options from our side: 

- Option A: Wed, Dec 13, 2028 — 10:00–11:00 PT (best for product + engineering leads)
- Option B: Thu, Dec 14, 2028 — 14:00–15:00 PT (works if you prefer a later afternoon window)

If neither works, send two preferred slots and we'll do our best to accommodate. Also: 
- We attached a draft agenda and a preliminary MAL quote for the Dedicated capacity work you asked about (attachments listed below).
- Quick ask for Procurement: can Evergreen share any internal PO/contract cadence constraints? We want to surface timing to legal and solutions before the demo.

Attachments: Evergreen_Agenda_v2.pdf, Evergreen_MAL_Quote_v3.xlsx

Next step: if you confirm a slot today, Hannah and Jonas will assemble a short technical appendix and a run-of-show.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0189

--

Date: Wed, 6 Dec 2028 09:01:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Evergreen renewal: QBR demo — slot options and procurement next steps

Thanks, Rachel.

Either slot could work but a couple notes: 
- We prefer Option B (Thu, Dec 14, 14:00 PT) because our CISO and head of infrastructure are traveling on Wed morning.
- Procurement note: our procurement team typically needs 10 business days to process an SOW/PO if there are no major redlines. If the MAL quote includes a hardware commitment, we may need an earlier heads-up so finance can reserve budget.

Looping in Procurement: procurement@evergreen.tech — can you confirm internal timing and whether a draft SOW would help accelerate?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the demo.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Director of Platform Engineering | Evergreen Health
liam.oconnor@evergreen.tech

Perfect — thanks for the quick note, Liam. Thu, Dec 14 at 14:00 PT it is. I've blocked a 60-minute meeting on the calendar and invited the Redwood leads.

Operational checklist before the session: 
- Hannah: final run-of-show + 2-slide tech appendix (due Mon EOD PT).
- Jonas: demo environment snapshot + test prompt set (due Tue EOD PT).
- Prıyom: confirm solutions lead availability and finalize the MAL quote (will attach the revised spreadsheet).
- Procurement/Evergreen: if you can share PO cadence or a sample contract template, legal can pre-review while we prep the demo — that typically trims 3–5 days off the procurement timeline.

I've attached a slightly tightened agenda and a refreshed MAL quote (see attachments). Also linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/EVG-2028-REN-42

Attachments: Evergreen_Agenda_v2.pdf, Evergreen_MAL_Quote_v3.xlsx, Demo_Slides_Draft.pptx

If procurement confirms the 10-business-day window, we should be in shape to sign before year-end.

Thanks all — see you on Dec 14.

Rachel
